title: デビュー戦の後に・我慢坂のはじまり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black manages to run the entirety of her debut race, but her face shows no signs of joy even after she crosses the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all her excitement, the terror of actually running a real race caught up with her, and all she could do was run like mad during it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's made painfully aware of how sloppy her running was today, and how such a performance will never reach anyone's heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, she'll need to build up experience with races suitable to her level to prepare for the Triple Crown next year.
